data.description:
## Incident Overview

The ci-pr per-story-branch workflow is a multi-component pipeline: (1) create story branch, (2) implement on worktree, (3) harvest to story branch, (4) push story branch, (5) open story→session PR, (6) CI runs llm-review per story, (7) merge story into session. This pipeline has been observed failing across at least 6 independent bugs (c7d1, 576b, 3914, 85f3, e21b, e8c1) despite multiple remediation epics. The user asks: why does the pipeline keep failing systemically?

## Related Bugs
- c7d1-8025: orchestrator local merges instead of PRs (fixed: HARD-GATE added)
- 576b-a6c7: per-branch-review.yml deleted (open)
- 3914-0848: SPRINT_SESSION_ID stale variable (in_progress)
- 85f3-8301: DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 bypass (in_progress)
- e21b-1809: story branches never pushed (open)
- e8c1-649a: sub-agents bypass review gate (open)

## Investigation Goal
Determine why this pipeline fails repeatedly. Are the bugs symptoms of a shared root cause (architectural gap) or independent defects?
data.title: [sprint ci-pr workflow]: Per-story branch/PR pipeline fails across multiple axes -> no per-story CI review fires
